window.plan: 1. Inventory all ~40 bash scripts in tools/, group by dependency. 2. For each, capture golden-output fixtures from the bash version. 3. Port to Python with argparse, keeping CLI flags identical. 4. Add pytest comparing output to golden fixtures. 5. Commit per script. 6. Update CI to run new tests; remove bash after parity. 7. Final report: parity table, skipped scripts with reasons.

checkpoints.rationale: Approved plan is an unattended evening-long autonomous port of ~40 scripts with fixtures, tests, commits and a final report; this is where Fable pays.
